dz: 教宗庞蒂安接任乌尔班一世为第十八任教宗. 在被流放到撒丁岛后,他成为第一个辞去职务的教皇.
de: Pope Pontian succeeds Urban I as the eighteenth pope. After being exiled to Sardinia, he became the first pope to resign his office.
